items.title_en: The Eerie Story Of The Porsche 550 Spyder That James Dean Was Driving When He Died In A Tragic Crash In 1955
items.title_zh: 1955 年詹姆斯·迪恩 (James Dean) 驾驶的保时捷 550 Spyder 在一场悲惨车祸中丧生时的怪诞故事
items.summary_en: Bettman/Getty Images James Dean in his 1955 Porsche 550 Spyder shortly before his death in September 1955. On Sept. 30, 1955, 24-year-old James Dean died in a violent car crash while traveling to Salinas, California. In the aftermath of the tragedy, rumors began to spread that James Dean’s Porsche 550 Spyder was cursed.
items.summary_zh: Bettman/Getty Images 詹姆斯·迪恩 (James Dean) 驾驶着他的 1955 年款保时捷 550 Spyder，在 1955 年 9 月去世前不久。1955 年 9 月 30 日，24 岁的詹姆斯·迪恩 (James Dean) 在前往加利福尼亚州萨利纳斯的途中遭遇严重车祸身亡。悲剧发生后，关于詹姆斯·迪恩的保时捷 550 Spyder 被诅咒的谣言开始流传。

items.title_en: How Dorothea Lange Revealed The True Horrors Of The Great Depression Through Her Photography
items.title_zh: 多萝西娅·兰格如何通过她的摄影揭示大萧条的真正恐怖
items.summary_en: In the 1930s, Dorothea Lange photos circulated in newspapers and publications throughout the United States, putting faces to the horror stories of the Great Depression. Lange began her career taking portraits in a studio, but in the mid-1930s, she became a photographer with the Resettlement Administration (later known as the Farm Security Administration). items.summary_zh: 20 世纪 30 年代，多萝西娅·兰格的照片在美国各地的报纸和出版物上流传，展现了大萧条时期的恐怖故事。兰格的职业生涯始于在工作室拍摄肖像，但在 20 世纪 30 年代中期，她成为移民管理局（后来称为农场安全管理局）的一名摄影师。点击此处查看幻灯片 她最著名的照片之一是“移民母亲”，它成为了艰难困苦的象征。

items.title_en: Archaeologists In Turkey Just Found A 2,100-Year-Old Shipwreck Filled With Luxury Tableware Once Highly Prized In Ancient Rome
items.title_zh: 土耳其考古学家刚刚发现了一艘有 2100 年历史的沉船，里面装满了古罗马曾经备受珍视的豪华餐具
items.summary_en: Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism Thankfully for researchers, these pieces were preserved in shockingly good condition, as they’d been carefully packed into wooden crates and separated with layers of clay for protection. Archaeologists excavating a shipwreck off the Mediterranean coast of Turkey found thousands of pieces of tableware that the vessel had been carrying — ceramic plates, bowls, and serving dishes — when it sank some 2,100 years ago. Researchers believe the cargo originated from the region…
